tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Brand Loyalty vs Attracting New Customers
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Next week, we will be discussing the impact of brand loyalty on consumer behavior. Brand loyalty refers to consumers consistently purchasing products from the same brand due to positive experiences and trust. Some marketers argue that building brand loyalty is essential for long-term success, while others believe that attracting new customers should be the priority. What do you think is more important for a company, building brand loyalty or attracting new customers?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Building brand loyalty is more important for long-term success. Loyal customers provide consistent revenue and often become brand advocates, attracting new customers through word-of-mouth recommendations.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Attracting new customers should be the priority. Expanding the customer base can lead to increased market share and growth opportunities. Focusing on new customers can also diversify the revenue streams for the company.
